title: Kokoro ONNX TTS adapter
summary: Adapter for Kokoro-82M speech through kokoro-onnx (lazy import, model loaded once, clear errors for missing model files) returning mono float32 samples for the TTS interface.
description: kokoro-onnx is MIT licensed and the Kokoro model is Apache-2.0 (per the kokoro-onnx README, checked 2026-10-10). The model files are not shipped here; download them from the kokoro-onnx releases page.

side_effects: loads ONNX model and voices files from local disk

review.notes: Unit tests pass with pytest on Python 3.13 (numpy, Pillow); ffmpeg integration tests ran with ffmpeg present.
